opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Head office, marketing support and running the global franchising machine — $682M of SG&A (including $107M of depreciation and amortization), plus $7M of other operating expense, net.

footerNote: The release's rounded lines do not tie exactly: operating income less interest expense plus nonoperating income gives pre-tax income of $2,329M, $1M below the printed $2,330M; this page follows the printed lines and the reported net income of $1,868M. Segment revenues as printed sum to $5,955M, $1M below the printed total revenue of $5,956M; that $1M rounding difference is carried in franchised revenues here.

oneTimers: Pre-tax charges of $66M ($0.07 per share), primarily restructuring charges under the 'Accelerating the Organization' program to modernize how the company works; excluding them, operating income fell 2% and EPS was $2.67.
otherDetail: Interest expense of $376M on McDonald's debt, partly offset by $57M of net nonoperating income.
segmentNote: Systemwide sales fell 1% (up 1% in constant currency); comparable sales: U.S. -3.6%, International Operated Markets -1.0%, International Developmental Licensed Markets +3.5%. Excluding the Leap Day comparison, global comparable sales were essentially flat.

segments.name: Franchised restaurants
segments.note: Rent and royalties paid by the local owners who run most McDonald's restaurants — the heart of the business model.

segments.name: Company-owned restaurants
segments.note: Food and drink sold at restaurants McDonald's runs itself.

segments.name: Other revenues
segments.note: Fees from franchisees for technology and digital platforms, plus brand-licensing income.

takeaways.text: Global comparable sales fell 1.0% — the U.S. -3.6% on fewer guest visits, International Operated Markets -1.0% with the U.K. weak, licensed markets +3.5% on the Middle East and Japan. Against a Leap Day quarter a year ago, comps were essentially flat.
takeaways.title: Comps dipped, mostly the calendar

takeaways.text: Diluted EPS was $2.60, down 2%. Excluding $66M of pre-tax restructuring charges under 'Accelerating the Organization', it was $2.67, down 1%. Net income was $1,868M.
takeaways.title: EPS eased 2%

takeaways.text: Franchise revenue — rent and royalties from other people's restaurants — was $3.7B, 61% of all revenue, and fell only 2%. Company-run store sales fell 9% to $2.1B, at much thinner margins.
takeaways.title: Franchisees carry the model

verdict: McDonald's revenue fell 3% to $6.0B and operating income 3% to $2.6B — comparable sales dipped 1.0% against a Leap Day quarter, with U.S. guest counts down — while franchise rent and royalties held up far better than company-run store sales.
